connector.name: Stellavault
connector.registryDescription: Local-first MCP server: Claude searches, asks & drafts from your Obsidian vault. 21 tools, no keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package stellavault. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
